requirements.name: Bidirectional route sequence
requirements.clause: The train follows the specified eight-stop bidirectional route cycle.

requirements.name: Initial arrival and travel interval
requirements.clause: The first arrival is at t=0 and consecutive stops are exactly 225 seconds apart.

requirements.name: Passenger initialization and identity
requirements.clause: Every station creates an initialization passenger at t=0.5; ordinary passenger IDs encode number, origin, and a distinct destination.

requirements.name: Clamped normal generation intervals
requirements.clause: Ordinary passenger intervals follow Normal(5,5) minutes, clamped to [1,9] and rounded to seconds.

requirements.name: Uniform conditional destinations
requirements.clause: Each passenger destination is selected uniformly from the four stations other than its origin.

requirements.name: Station FIFO queues
requirements.clause: Passengers board in generation order at their origin station.

requirements.name: Serial boarding and alighting delays
requirements.clause: Boarding and alighting occur serially at 0.025-second increments after train arrival.

requirements.name: Passenger lifecycle integrity
requirements.clause: Passengers board only after generation at their origin and exit only after boarding at their destination.

requirements.name: Scheduled observable activity
requirements.clause: Each configured test horizon exposes enough passenger and train activity to exercise its stated route segment.
